summary:
TerraWatch is an Earth observation web platform that translates NASA-ISRO Synthetic Aperture Radar (NISAR) satellite data into intuitive, actionable surface change intelligence for farmers, researchers, and disaster response teams. Complex radar backscatter and interferometry often require advanced remote sensing expertise to interpret. TerraWatch solves this by automating the entire processing pipeline across four specialized modules: WaterWatch (floods and wetlands), ForestWatch (canopy disturbance and deforestation), AgroWatch (agricultural soil moisture and crop emergence), and GeoMotion (earthquakes and land subsidence).
The platform features high-resolution satellite basemaps, an interactive before-and-after comparison slider, automatically generated change detection maps, and plain-English AI explanations powered by the Gemini API that strictly interpret verified mathematical calculations without hallucination. By bridging the gap between raw L-band satellite radar arrays and everyday decision-makers, TerraWatch democratizes Earth observation for climate resilience and community disaster preparedness.
details:
TerraWatch – Earth Surface Change Intelligence Platform

TerraWatch is a full-stack platform developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge under the theme “Dancing with the SARs.” It uses NASA-ISRO NISAR satellite radar data to detect and visualize changes on Earth's surface.

Key Features

WaterWatch: Detects floods and flooded vegetation.

ForestWatch: Identifies forest loss, logging and wildfire damage.

AgroWatch: Monitors soil moisture and irrigation changes.

GeoMotion: Measures ground movement, including earthquake-related displacement and land subsidence.

Problem & Impact

Satellite radar data is difficult for ordinary people to understand. TerraWatch converts this data into easy-to-read maps and visual reports, helping farmers, administrators and disaster response teams identify affected areas and understand environmental changes.

Technologies Used

Frontend: React.js, Tailwind CSS, Leaflet

Backend: Python, FastAPI

Processing: NumPy, Pandas, Rasterio, h5py

Database: SQLite

AI: Google Gemini API

Data: NASA-ISRO NISAR satellite products

Unique Features

Side-by-side satellite comparison and interactive change maps.

Supports location selection anywhere on Earth.

Allows users to upload and inspect real NISAR HDF5 data.

Provides affected-area statistics and AI-generated explanations based on actual processing results.
